title: Elizondo says Monsanto-linked people are coming after him

tellings.quote: he says that some of the people coming after him are involved in Monsanto and there's this Monsanto Becktell connection from back in the day and they were maybe involved in the UFO alien issue as well.

plain: A former Pentagon official named Luis Elizondo says some of the people coming after him are tied to Monsanto, the agrochemical company, Michels reports, passing on what Elizondo has said. Michels adds that there is a 'Monsanto Becktell connection from back in the day', and that those people may also have been involved in the UFO question. If so, corporate interests would be working against someone who talks publicly about UFOs.
